page.nudgeTitle: Connect your TeamSpeak server to get started
page.nudgeDescription: Add a connection under Settings to manage channels, clients, bots, and more.
page.selectFromHeader: Select a server connection from the header to view the dashboard.

errors.queryStarting: TeamSpeak Query is still coming up after startup. Wait a moment and retry.
errors.connectFailed: Could not connect to the TeamSpeak server. Check your connection settings.
errors.liveStarting: TeamSpeak Query is still starting. Live data may be incomplete until it comes online.
errors.liveRefreshFailed: Live data refresh failed. The last successful snapshot is still displayed.

source.hintDisabled: Dashboard uses authenticated WebQuery only. Native metrics scrape is off for this connection.
source.hintCurrent: WebQuery identity plus scoped TeamSpeak native Prometheus metrics.
source.hintUnreachable: Metrics scrape could not connect. Ensure TSSERVER_METRICS_ENABLED=1 and TSSERVER_METRICS_IP is reachable from the manager (not localhost-only when the manager is remote), and that metricsHost/port match.
source.hintTimeout: Metrics scrape did not finish before the dashboard returned. A later refresh may pick up a cached scrape if the listener is reachable.
source.hintInvalid: Metrics response was rejected (HTTP status, content-type, or empty/invalid samples).
source.hintUnscoped: Metrics samples could not be proven to match this virtual server identity; WebQuery values were kept.
source.hintUnavailable: Native metrics are enabled but unavailable; dashboard kept WebQuery values.

traffic.description: Incoming and outgoing bandwidth over the latest local samples
